rules.name: NAME1
rules.label: vendors
rules.notes: SMTP_ADDR was categorized as CONTEXT due to low value distinctness (8.6%), likely indicating shared corporate or placeholder email addresses.

why.LIFNR: key - Primary key identifying the vendor master record.
why.KTOKK: context - Account group categorizes vendors but does not identify duplicate entities.
why.NAME1: name - Primary legal and trading name of the vendor used for entity matching.
why.NAME2: context - Additional name line with low fill rate (34.3%), helpful only as supplemental context.
why.STRAS: location - Street address populated in 100% of rows to corroborate name matches.
why.ORT01: location - City location corroborating vendor entity matches.
why.PSTLZ: location - Postal code field supporting geographic location verification.
why.LAND1: location - Country key defining the primary location context.
why.TELF1: identifier - Main phone number with 99.0% distinctness serving as a strong standalone entity identifier.
why.SMTP_ADDR: context - Email field has a low distinctness rate (8.6%), indicating generic or shared values that could cause false positives if matched directly.
why.STCD1: identifier - Tax and VAT identifier with 98.1% distinctness providing unique legal entity identification.
why.LOEVM: context - Deletion flag indicating record status during review.

rules.label: vendor company code settings
rules.notes: LFB1 contains company-code-specific financial data for vendors; matching should be conducted at the vendor master level (LFA1) using LIFNR as key.

why.LIFNR: key - LIFNR is the vendor account number linking company code settings to the core vendor entity.
why.BUKRS: context - Company code indicates the financial organizational unit for these settings.
why.AKONT: context - GL reconciliation account is an accounting setting rather than an entity identifier.
why.ZTERM: context - Payment terms represent vendor transaction settings within this company code.
why.ZWELS: context - Allowed payment methods are organizational configuration settings with low variation across rows.
why.HBKID: context - House bank key is internal master configuration data and not an identifying attribute of the vendor.

why.LIFNR: key - Identifies the vendor business object owning the bank details, where one vendor may have multiple bank accounts.
why.BANKS: identifier - Specifies the bank country, which forms a composite identifier when combined with the bank key and account number.
why.BANKL: identifier - Provides the routing key, required together with bank country and account number to identify the specific account.
why.BANKN: identifier - Holds the bank account number, which combined with bank country and bank key identifies the account.
why.BKONT: context - A control key field with extremely low cardinality (0.1% distinct) useful only as background context.
why.KOINH: name - Contains the account holder name used for exact and fuzzy name matching. NOT used for matching: this table has no location columns to confirm a name match.
why.IBAN: identifier - Serves as a standalone globally unique identifier for international bank accounts (97.6% distinct).

why.LIFNR: key - Vendor Account Number serving as the primary key reference to the vendor master record.
why.EKORG: context - Purchasing organization context for the vendor terms, having low distinctness (0.4%).
why.WAERS: context - Order currency associated with the purchasing organization terms.
why.ZTERM: context - Purchasing payment terms provided for reviewer comparison.

why.MATNR: key - Primary key of the material master table with 100% fill rate and 100% uniqueness.
why.MTART: context - Material type classifies items into broad functional groups with only 1.2% distinct values.
why.MATKL: context - Material group categorizes items into merchandise categories with 1.6% distinct values.
why.MEINS: context - Base unit of measure indicates the stocking unit with 0.5% distinct values.
why.BISMT: identifier - Old material number contains legacy predecessor article identifiers with 96.8% distinctness when populated.
why.EAN11: identifier - EAN/GTIN barcode is an industry standard unique entity identifier with 98.1% distinct values.
why.BRGEW: context - Gross weight provides useful physical attribute context during side-by-side review.
why.MSTAE: context - Cross-plant material status shows operational blocks that help reviewers assess duplicate record state.
why.LVORM: context - Deletion indicator indicates whether a record is flagged for deletion, crucial context during duplicate review.

why.MATNR: key - Serves as the material key in SAP, forming the primary composite key together with WERKS.
why.WERKS: key - Specifies the plant code and completes the composite primary key alongside MATNR.
why.EKGRP: context - Purchasing group responsible for procurement of the material at this plant.
why.DISPO: context - MRP controller responsible for planning this material at the plant level.
why.DISMM: context - Defines the MRP planning type strategy for plant material control.
why.BESKZ: context - Indicates the procurement type (in-house or external procurement) for this plant material.
why.PLIFZ: context - Planned delivery time in days, providing lead-time operational context.
why.EISBE: context - Safety stock quantity specified for inventory planning at this plant.
why.MINBE: context - Reorder point threshold value used for reorder-point MRP planning.
why.MAABC: context - ABC material classification indicator at plant level.

why.MATNR: key - Material Number is part of the primary key identifying the material in table MARD.
why.WERKS: key - Plant code forms part of the composite primary key identifying the organizational location.
why.LGORT: key - Storage Location forms part of the primary key specifying the stock location.
why.LABST: context - Unrestricted stock quantity provides key operational context for stock evaluation.
why.INSME: context - Quality inspection stock quantity provides secondary stock context.
why.SPEME: context - Blocked stock quantity provides context, though 99.8% of values are identical.
why.LGPBE: context - Storage Bin indicates physical location details within the storage location.

rules.label: material valuation records
rules.notes: MBEW is an SAP standard table for material valuation; records are uniquely identified by Material Number (MATNR) and Valuation Area (BWKEY).

why.MATNR: key - Material number forms the core business key identifying the material record.
why.BWKEY: key - Valuation area forms the second component of the primary key alongside MATNR.
why.VPRSV: context - Price control indicator ('S' vs 'V') provides important accounting context for valuation comparison.
why.BKLAS: context - Valuation class links the material to general ledger account determination.
why.VERPR: context - Moving average price gives pricing context for comparison between records.
why.STPRS: context - Standard price gives fixed valuation pricing context.
why.PEINH: context - Price unit denominator provides scaling context for standard and moving average prices.
why.LBKUM: context - Total valuated stock quantity provides inventory context.
why.SALK3: context - Total stock value provides monetary context for total inventory on hand.

rules.label: material sales views
rules.notes: MVKE contains sales-specific data for materials; entity names and base attributes reside in MARA/MAKT tables.

why.MATNR: key - Foreign key to MARA identifying the material business object that owns these sales views.
why.VKORG: context - Defines the sales organization for this material record context.
why.VTWEG: context - Defines the distribution channel context for the sales view.
why.DWERK: context - Delivering plant assignment provides key operational context for reviewers.
why.MTPOS: context - Item category group controlling sales order processing behavior, useful reviewer context.
why.LVORM: context - Sales level deletion flag indicating record status during side-by-side review.
